data.raw_text:
No announcement yet, but US-PH market is about to get even more interesting with Delta's reported return to MNL - this time from LAX. 

Just prior to the pandemic, Delta closed its Tokyo Narita hub in favor of Haneda. Along with shifting its US-Tokyo flights to HND, the airline's MNL services would be shifted to Incheon in South Korea. 

Delta is now going for a direct US-Philippine service. While LAX is highly competitive - it is a Delta stronghold. Probably the best way to return to Manila with connecting traffic similar to how UA does at SFO.
